subject: Taxes
title: The Pilgrimage of Grace
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Pilgrimage of Grace.

hook.text: In 1536, 40,000 English rebels marched against Henry VIII.

buildup.text: Henry dissolved monasteries and seized their wealth.

discovery.text: The rebellion wasn't anti-tax—it protested the loss of services taxes had funded. Cut the services, face the revolt.

twist.text: Henry promised reform, then executed 200 leaders. He kept the monastery wealth and offered nothing in return.

climax.text: The Pilgrimage shows that people accept taxes when they see benefits.

punchline.text: Take the services, keep the taxes. That's how revolts are born.

quiz.question: What triggered the Pilgrimage of Grace?
options: Dissolution of monasteries and loss of services
